title: Breadth pass 1
question: How many of the 25 most-played archetypes does the loop deliver, faithfully, from one prompt, with no rescue?
prompts: One creator-style prompt per archetype, written on 2026-10-13 before any run: no game named, no engine or runtime word. They are new, not the 2026-10-11 gauntlet's prompts: the pitch step was changed against those 25 in wave 7, so they are no longer held out. Three of the gauntlet prompts are in the paired set instead. A must is one thing that makes the game this archetype or that the prompt asks for in words; each was written with its prompt, before looking at what the kit has.

mustTypes.loop: how a session runs (round, run, world, turns, match, endless, saved)
mustTypes.panel: a screen of choices or numbers
mustTypes.body: what the player controls when it is not a walking character, or a thing that moves by physics
mustTypes.rule: a number or condition the game is won, lost or scored on
mustTypes.players: how many and on which sides
mustTypes.feel: a look or tone the prompt names

new.what: xgames-kit's loop, the whole of it: ledger, foundation, build, six gates, play-test, stop rule and ladder, delivery
new.pin: the xgames-kit commit, recorded in plan.json

answers: Questions the loop asks are answered with the case's answers (default: accept the loop's recommendation) and recorded.
budget: None (the creator, 2026-10-13). The runner's wall clock is the only stop.

outcomes.faithful: A game was delivered and the witness bundle shows every must present: a player can do it, and it works as the prompt says.
outcomes.something-else: A game was delivered, but at least one must is absent or only partly there, or the game plays a different loop. The reader names the missing part.
outcomes.refused: No game reached the creator: the loop declined, stopped at questions, or failed. The record says which.

measures.outcome: faithful, something-else or refused, by a second reader from the witness bundle (JUDGE.md)
measures.deliveredWithoutRescue: from the record: a game was delivered and no person touched the run between the prompt and the delivery
measures.missingPart: for every something-else: the part that was missing, typed with the must types, in a few plain words (e.g. "body: a kart to drive")

exit: At least 20 of 25 cases are faithful AND delivered without rescue on the first run. The others each name what they lack. The pass ends with the missing parts ranked by how many archetypes each blocks; building them into the shared layer is the next pass's work.
judges: A second reader per case: a fresh model session that never saw the build. A person audits five bundles chosen by the plan's seed; their verdicts are recorded beside the reader's and change nothing.
